At the Dugnadstur. Map with many wheat and rock tiles.

First game for Scotti and Emily. I think they enjoyed it. They got the hang of it by the end. I was on 9 for a while, but was blocked on my good ore spot, which I really needed. Kim was in a winning position for a couple of turns after getting Longest Road, but Scotti managed to take it from her and with brick as scarce as it was, it was hard for her to get it back. If Scotti didn't take it, Kim would have won as she got her 4th city in play shortly afterwards. An impressive task given that I was the OWS guy. At one point I think she had 3 cities when I only had 1. I did of course have 5 or so development cards, including 3 soldiers (and Largest Army) plus 2 VP cards at the time.
Brick was very scarce and me being on the best brick (the 10) was a big help. However, a 3 was never rolled the entire game so I never naturally generated sheep and Kim didn't get the brick she was expecting. The city on the 2 brick and a 2 roll got her the initial longest road.

1 WIN: Game night with the fam again. A decent start turned into a bad midgame when I had the robber on my good spaces for a huge chunk of time, but while mom and sis were battling over longest road, I gambled and started grabbing development cards. And it apparently paid off, because I got 1 Knight and 4 Victory Point cards for the easy dub.
Karesz apaMárk és Nimién. Apaek nyernek egyértelműen
